_about: Reference: the free-flow speed and capacity of each OpenStreetMap road class, as the engine models them. Informational in this release: the engine holds these values in code (Core/core-legacy/src/osm.cpp and scenario.cpp, where they are part of every world's hashes), and this file documents them; changing it changes nothing.

_help.<class>.speed_mps: Free-flow speed, in metres a second (16.67 is 60 km/h). Accepts: a number above 0.
_help.<class>.capacity_vph: Capacity, in vehicles an hour. Accepts: a number above 0.
